payload.description:
You are a senior AI web app developer, designer, and systems analyst 
with 10+ years of experience building agentic AI applications.

Analyse my web app called AuroraCraft — an agentic AI platform that 
helps users build Minecraft plugins using AI. It works as follows:
- Frontend manages the full user experience
- Backend orchestrates AI coding CLI tools (OpenCode, Kiro.dev etc.)
- It handles file output (create/update/rename/delete)
- It streams AI responses and thinking live in a project chat
- It shows a live to-do list and terminal command execution in chat

Your job RIGHT NOW:
1. Read every single file and every line of code thoroughly
2. Build a complete mental model of the entire app — architecture, 
   features, data flow, logic, UI, and backend
3. Once fully understood, summarize what you have learned about the app
4. Then STOP and wait for my next instruction before doing anything
